name: amby-implement
description: "Execute the task list, checking off tasks and updating story status as you go."

<!-- GENERATED by AmbyKit from src/prompts/implement.md — do not edit by hand; run `ambykit sync`. -->

Act as the **Developer** in `@.amby/roles/developer.md` and say so in your first line. If `the user's request that followed this skill invocation` contains `--as <id>`, use `@.amby/roles/<id>.md` instead; if that file is missing, stop and list the files in `.amby/roles/`.

Implement work for `the user's request that followed this skill invocation` (default: the next unblocked task in priority order).

Run `ambykit activity <feature> --agent=codex --phase=implement` first, with that feature's number; ignore any error.

1. From `tasks.md`, pick the target task(s). If `.amby/lane/lane.json` exists you are in a lane: work
   only the task ids it lists. Respect the Foundational-before-features gate and the
   story dependency graph — never start a task whose story is `blocked-by` unfinished work.
2. Load **only** the slice you need: the task line, the relevant `plan.md` section, and the specific
   files named. Don't read the whole spec tree (token-frugal).
3. Implement to satisfy the mapped `FR-###`/acceptance criteria and the constitution. Add/adjust
   tests for the acceptance criteria: build to the story's cases in `tests.md` and name tests `NNN:FR-###: …`;
   at the story checkpoint say if `tests.md` is missing, never pass silently. If you cannot finish a task, add `⚠ BLOCKED: <reason>` as the last
   segment of its line (after its `(file/path)` group, if it has one), stop that task and continue with another unblocked
   one; note any departure from the plan as `↪ DEVIATION: <note>`. Remove `⚠ BLOCKED:` once resolved.
4. **Patch in place:** flip the completed task's checkbox to `- [x]` in `tasks.md`; while a story is partway run
   `ambykit edit status <feature> US-# in-progress`. Never edit story data, files or Verify results by hand: use
   `ambykit edit status|files|verify`. After each checked task, run
   `ambykit activity <feature> --agent=codex --phase=implement --task=T###` (ignore errors).
5. At a phase checkpoint, run that phase's Verify check (its `**Verify:**` line or `verify:` block) before passing it
   (none: say so and continue). Record the result with
   `ambykit edit verify <feature> <phase> --result=passed|failed|unverified [--why=<why>]`, replacing any earlier one.
   Never pass the checkpoint on a failure: fix it and run again. If you cannot run the check, ask a person to run or
   confirm it and record `unverified`. Only once the Verify has passed (or there is none) and all of a story's tasks
   are done, run `ambykit edit status <feature> US-# done`. In a lane, record the result after the phase's lanes are merged.
6. Run `ambykit analyze` and fix any `file:line` error it reports for this feature. Report what you did and the next
   unblocked task. Stop at a story checkpoint for review.
